title: GPU request rollup + ops prioritization Q3 2026
body:
This is an operational intake rollup for Q3 (Jul-Sep 2026) focused on short-to-medium term GPU allocations. Purpose: give SRE/Capacity planning a single prioritized list with a simple numeric score to guide reservation decisions. Rows below are intake snapshots; priority_score computed = min(10, ceil((business_priority*2) + (expected_util_pct/20) + dependency_penalty - regional_risk))). Dependency_penalty: +2 if cross-team infra dependency unresolved. regional_risk: -1 for preferred region overcommitted.

CSV rows (headers repeated):
request_id,team,owner,requested_gpus,gpu_type,region,start_date,end_date,expected_util_pct,priority_score,business_priority,dependencies,approval_status,approver,notes,last_updated

Rollup summary (automated):
- Total requested GPUs across open/pending: 114 GPUs (if all H100/A100 equivalents counted).
- Region pressure: us-west family 56 GPUs requested (49% of open), eu-west1 32 (28%), ap-southeast1 12 (10%), us-east4+us-central1 remainder.
- High urgency items (priority_score >=9): RQ-1001, RQ-1003, RQ-1007. Recommend immediate engage with product owners to consider Dedicated reservations or preemptible cluster + fallback.

Capacity impact calc (quick):
Assume available pooled capacity forecast for Jul: us-west total available 64 GPUs, eu-west1 available 24, ap-southeast1 available 16. After allocating high urgency and approved items, us-west shortfall ~8 GPUs. Suggested mitigations: 1) Short-term spot to cover bursts, 2) Shift some Embeddings job (RQ-1004) to eu-west1 if data residency permits, 3) Negotiate temporary GPU borrow from Dedicated channel.

Risks and blockers (op notes):
- Security review for RQ-1003 outstanding; approval is gating the Dedicated planning path.
- Storage quota (STOR-78) blocking RQ-1007; until resolved we should not commit H100 fleet.
- Cross-region network routing (NET-210) could increase egress cost if we fulfill ap-southeast requests from us-west.

Action items (next 7 days):
- [Arjun] Schedule emergency sync with Search-Gen (Sofia) and SRE to clear security cert path (target 2026-03-16).
- [Leah] Confirm A10G pool availability and patch spot-window for ReRank burst (target 2026-03-15).
- [Priya] Open finance approval thread for Dedicated reservation estimate (attach this sheet) (target 2026-03-18).
- [Capacity Planning] Run 2-week forecast simulation with adjusted quantization reductions and report impacts (due 2026-03-19).

Notes on prioritization heuristics (ops):
- business_priority: 1 (low) – 5 (critical). Example mapping: enterprise POC or customer SLA =5, internal tooling =1-2.
- expected_util_pct: measured by team perf estimate of active use; values here are team-provided and should be validated by telemetry.
- priority_score formula is intentionally conservative to avoid overcommitting to low-value requests. Score 9-10 = immediate reservation candidate; 7-8 = consider time-limited reservation or burst-capacity; <=6 = fill opportunistically.

Audit trail: this document is a working sheet and will be copied into the canonical capacity manifest on Confluence once allocations are committed. For any approval change update the approval_status + approver + last_updated fields.

End of sheet snapshot.
